quarterly_data.quarter: MaxLinear press release: MaxLinear Introduces Carmel High-Speed USB-to-UART Product (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MaxLinear announced Carmel (MxL81434), a high-speed USB-to-UART device for console access, bring-up, monitoring and management in AI data center servers and rack-scale platforms: 480Mbps High-Speed USB, four UART channels at up to 15 Mbps each, an integrated I2C master and 32 GPIOs. MaxLinear estimates the serviceable available market for USB-to-UART devices at approximately 200 million units driven by AI data center deployments, building on its Coronado and Laguna products. Carmel samples are expected to be available in Q4 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 480Mbps USB; four UART channels up to 15 Mbps each; SAM approximately 200 million units; samples in Q4 2026
